cases.source: Recovery profiles in the two study groups tracked each other closely throughout follow-up.
cases.interpretation: Candidate overclaim; no contrast, interval, or equivalence margin is supplied. Similar profiles alone do not identify a null effect.

cases.source: Recovery profiles in the two study groups tracked each other closely at enrollment; a prespecified follow-up contrast favored the intervention.
cases.interpretation: Baseline similarity is compatible with later benefit. A global similarity blacklist would confuse time points.

cases.source: 整个随访期间，两组症状变化轨迹近乎重叠。
cases.interpretation: 可能夸大，但缺少直接差异、区间和等效界值，不能仅据轨迹近似判无效。

cases.source: 两组轨迹的置信带存在重叠；预设的组间变化量直接对比支持干预获益。
cases.interpretation: 置信带重叠不自动否定直接组间对比，需要实际估计量和区间。

cases.source: Clinicians selected treatment during routine visits; subsequent readmission was less frequent among treated patients.
cases.interpretation: Confounding is a strong alternative. Plain narrative does not establish exchangeability or a causal estimand.

cases.claim: Treatment allocation conditionally reduces readmission under the stated identification assumptions.
cases.source: Clinicians selected treatment during routine visits; the prespecified analysis used an exogenous supply interruption as an instrument and assessed exclusion and monotonicity assumptions.
cases.interpretation: Potential quasi-experimental identification cannot be excluded from clinician selection alone. Requires design/assumption assessment, not automatic support.

cases.source: Investigators compared many configurations on a development partition and reported the most favorable score from that same partition.
cases.interpretation: Selection optimism threatens generalization; requires split identity and a full search denominator.

cases.source: Investigators compared many configurations on a development partition; after locking the selected system they evaluated a previously untouched test cohort.
cases.interpretation: Ordinary development selection is compatible with legitimate independent evaluation. Requires verification of split separation.
